Embedding request with explicit encoding_format of float returns float array embeddings

```swift title="Swift"
import LiterLlm

let _request = try LiterLlm.embeddingRequestFromJson("{\"encoding_format\":\"float\",\"input\":\"Test input\",\"model\":\"text-embedding-3-small\"}")
let result = try await LiterLlm.embed(request: _request)
print(result)
```
